sources.title: NousResearch/Arete-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Arete-27B is intended for general assistance and agentic work where users want this change in viewpoint, and for research into how post-training changes a model's values and behavior. We encourage the community to test it against their own requirements and continue experimenting with value-alignment.

sources.title: Introducing Arete-27B: Qwen3.8-27B Post-Trained To Reinforce Western ...
sources.snippet: We post-trained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model, and measured what changed with an 803-prompt eval across seven value categories.
